title: Linden Memberships Holding Rule: One Membership per Patient
content:
## Clauses

1. **Limit.** A patient holds at most 1 membership of Linden Memberships at a time, whether as the primary member or as a dependent on a Linden Family Membership.
2. **Condition for a new enrollment.** A new enrollment is made only for a patient who holds no membership in status pending, active, frozen, past due or cancellation pending. This is judged from the group's membership records for that patient, not from the patient's own account of what they hold.
3. **Changing tier.** A change of tier is made on the existing membership, never by enrolling a second one.

## Which existing memberships count

| Status of a membership the patient already holds | Counts against the limit of 1 |
|---|---|
| Pending (enrolled, first dues not yet paid) | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Frozen | Yes |
| Past due | Yes |
| Cancellation pending (notice given, not yet in effect) | Yes |

A membership in any of these five statuses is a membership the patient holds, and a second enrollment for that patient is not made while it exists.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A patient's only earlier membership shows status cancelled. None of the five listed statuses is present, so clause 2 is met for a new enrollment.
- A patient has a Linden Essential Membership in status frozen and asks to join the Linden Plus Membership. The frozen membership is held, so no second membership is enrolled; a move between tiers is a change of tier on the existing membership (clause 3).
- A patient is a dependent on a relative's Linden Family Membership that is active. That patient already holds a membership as a dependent and is not enrolled in a second one.
- A patient gave notice of cancellation last week and the notice has not yet taken effect. The membership is in cancellation pending, which counts; a new enrollment is not made while it stands.
